name: deepseek-v4-pro-0813
description: A flagship Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 1.6 trillion total parameters and 49 billion activated parameters, natively supporting a million-token context window. Trained on vast amounts of high-quality data, it delivers leading capabilities in mathematical reasoning, complex problem-solving, professional code generation, and in-depth analysis of long-form content. It is well suited for demanding scenarios such as advanced research, complex knowledge work, and sophisticated agentic workflows.
zhDescription: 旗舰级 MoE 大模型，总参1.6T、激活 49B，原生支持百万级超长上下文。依托海量高质量训练数据，具备顶尖数学逻辑、复杂推理、专业代码与长文本深度解析能力，适配高阶科研、复杂办公、深度智能代理等高难度场景。
